eye_puppet.method: Complete native upper/lower cutouts on continuous 64x41 grids. Shared five-pin closed lines sit near mid-eye with shallow arches, inspired by BV1rR4y1N7q4 at54–55s. Both lids retain native x; lower closure follows p*(0.7+0.3*p), rises and flattens onto the upper line. Long lash roots lie on the native stroke; tips shorten along their measured directions, then the mesh samples both guide curves at the displaced x. Broad smooth root gathering reduces hooked corners; original UV and alpha remain intact. Static iris/sclera are spatially occluded by the opening. True brows and separate crease parts remain controllable. No generated poses, lash clipping, expression switches or temporal crossfade.
eye_puppet.controls: 30 Marker2D pins; native brow meshes synchronized with upper closure; separate EyeEdgeDetail1/2 sprites; fixed StationaryHair sprite; Inspector Resource, no panel
eye_puppet.time_driver: continuous analytic time parameter; same geometry path for closing/opening; no AnimationPlayer pose keys or expression image sequence
eye_puppet.cutout_policy: Whole upper and whole lower native cutouts, one 64x41 grid per lid; true brows retained as native ribbons, small creases separate, marked hair excluded from moving lash cutouts

deformation_details.occlusion_aa: eye-body gate only; no lash clipping
deformation_details.lower_meeting_mode: shared five-pin line sampled at native x for both lids

root_depth_gather.method: C1 whole cross-section compression evaluated at warped x

near_eye_sidewall_excess.method: Subtract progress*side_weight*excess^2/(excess+1) only from long positive side-wall depth after original root gathering; preserve upper stroke, native x transport and open/closed poses

deformation_details.guide_resampling: source and moving ridges at directionally warped x

reference.timing_policy: Close plus reopen to70% together0.3s (0.15+0.15); final30% in1.7s; reference only for shape hierarchy

closed_outer_tail_softening.mapping: monotone C1 x gathering for whole lids and eye-body gate; original UV/alpha unchanged

hidden_underlay.method: gpt-image-2 completes both eye-free footprints with continuous native-style skin/hair; registered and gradient-matched to native a; static background only, no generated expression frames
hidden_underlay.forbidden: manual color fills or broad skin/hair inpaint ribbons

stationary_hair_ownership.method: Static alpha-conserving transfer of marked native hair from upper and lower cutouts into StationaryHair; inspect both eyelid mattes for residual hair, no animated clipping
stationary_hair_ownership.right_eye: Marked native hair below outer corner transferred from lower-lid into StationaryHair; precise polygon with no color-difference rejection
